source.preservation: Read-only prepared original; hash before and after any future job. Never save or convert the original.

scope.limitations: Static filename references identify candidates only; neither absence of a string nor class membership proves consumer behavior. No completeness of the consumer set is claimed.

authorization.execution_gate: Before any edit/build, obtain a grant naming material hashes, permitted operations, provider/operator, licensed authoring environment, output/publication limits and disposal. Current official headless container cannot author/edit LabVIEW source (docs/perpetua/environment.md). #169 native inspection/experiment capability is unavailable; a grant alone supplies neither capability nor license permission.

questions.question: What are the original root type, typedef/strictness settings and default value, at which native property/object locators?
Which candidate terminals actually bind to this original typedef, and which are disconnected or unrelated?

consumer_candidates.static_evidence: Bounded raw-byte search of the 9763-byte original found ASCII Dequeue Priority.ctl at zero-based offsets 2449 and 2484, adjacent to TDCC/PTH0 labels. These are byte locators, not decoded native terminal bindings.

Bounded search of all 6847 original bytes found no ASCII Dequeue Priority string. Shared Message Dequeuer class naming makes this a candidate control only; compressed references and indirect dependencies remain possible.

edit_recipes.preconditions: In an authorized native authoring environment confirm that the selected CTL is a typedef and capture its complete root type/default and strictness. If it is not a typedef or cannot be edited legally, stop and record recipe blocked; do not silently substitute an original.
steps: Create two isolated complete dependency-tree copies, baseline and variant, from preserved hashed originals; ensure neither resolves dependencies into the original or other copy. Log all resolved paths.

In the variant CTL only, replace the root control with a cluster containing a copy of the complete original root control named original_value and a Boolean named impact_probe default false. Preserve typedef/strictness mode and original_value default; record native before/after object maps and save-version changes.

Save only derived variant files. Open each candidate in each isolated tree with identical native settings; record propagation, broken wires, coercions, load errors and every implicitly modified dependency. Do not repair consumers or disconnect typedefs.

Hash every derived before/after artifact and capture native differences; a broken consumer is an observation, not a successful execution. Builds remain separately gated and are unnecessary for this observation plan.

observation_procedure: Record native version/build, OS, license, modules, target, source save versions, dependencies and inaccessible diagrams. Resolve each candidate binding using native type properties and terminal/object maps before classifying affected/unaffected.

Capture original CTL properties and each candidate diagram/connector in baseline, then the same views in variant. Native comparison must identify semantic changes separately from automatic resave/conversion noise, with original and derived hashes and capture hashes.

Before runs or reader exposure, a preparer freezes a hashed fixture manifest: create/reset an isolated queue, enqueue two distinguishable messages at distinct valid priorities confirmed natively, then dequeue; include empty queue with a bounded timeout and invalid queue reference. Record exact message payloads, priority values, timeout, initial state, output/error comparison rules and reset/release steps. Unknown numeric inputs are a gap, not inferred from filenames.

For the candidate negative control freeze valid and invalid reference fixtures. Run identical baseline/variant fixtures only when loadable and authorized, preserving exact outputs/errors and bounded timeout logs; if the changed consumer breaks, record nonexecution instead of repairing it. Compare full typed values and errors exactly; do not infer ordering guarantees from one run.

Freeze fixture hashes and resolved object locators in a separately reviewed case revision before reader exposure. Currently these native fixtures and locators are unavailable under #169; no runnable oracle is claimed.
checker_steps: Run python3 -I -B benchmark/scripts/change_cases.py --check; structural validation is not semantic approval.

After provisioning and authorization, an independent checker resolves TI-01 through TI-04 and every observation ID against original/native evidence, never reader output; record checker identity, session, case revision and per-ID agreement/disagreement.

Verify original preservation, copy isolation, edit fidelity, source/capture/fixture hashes, affected and negative-control observations, controlled inputs/state/errors, and version-pinned documentation. Disagreement or missing evidence blocks the affected key.

Keep all four required claims in separate correctness and grounding denominators and all four observation IDs in fidelity. Apply protocol omission/extra/contradiction rules; unavailability cannot earn semantic credit.
